notes.title: win RUNEYANA FREE key !!! - by playing runeyana demo!!!
notes.content:
INSTRUCTIONS! 


1. Search the troll on the top of the rock! 

2. kill him! 

3. make print screen with the dead troll before his corpse disappears! 
or prinscreen the drop left after his death ( 10lvl skin or bone - dark blue) 
if you took the drop, then print screen it directly from your inventory! 

THE KEY IS YOURS - CONGRATULATIONS!
